title: Synthetic orchestration template: Hearthstone analytics

definitionOfDone.text: Verify provenance, format separation and unknown-data behavior across all accepted deliverables with independent project evidence; no real game statistics are supplied.

constraints: Replace root with an existing owned absolute Git root with an initial commit. This is an orchestration template, not an implemented analytics service.
Game modes Standard, Wild and Battlegrounds are separate populations. Patch/version, observation window, region, ranks/MMR, sample size and source coverage are unknown; do not infer or merge them.

Use synthetic offline fixtures only. Source endpoints, licenses, access rights and collection method are unknown until verified; no live scraping, authenticated calls or real player data in this example.

Execution mode is separate from game format: configure kodo.config.json explicitly. Suggested offline planning: executionMode quick, maxTasks 1, researchBudget 0, repairRounds 1, concurrency 1; Project CLI has no --mode or --model flags.

Future GPT/Claude work uses signed-in subscription clients only, preserving fixed models and lower saved budgets. No credentials, API fallback, invented win rates, meta rankings or statistically unsupported recommendations.

Empty interfaceRefs and architectureRefs mean no frozen evidence has been supplied. Resolve and verify needed interfaces before future execution. Accepted tasks do not replace container-specific proof.
businessContext: Illustrative backlog for source-aware Hearthstone reporting. A missing patch, denominator or comparable population must remain unknown. Synthetic fixture values never describe the current game or a real deck.

acceptance.text: Verify provenance and unknowns end to end without claiming real game findings.
Independent proof covers format isolation, denominators and unknown patch/source rejection.

tasks.title: Define provenance and population contract
tasks.description: Specify required patch/version, format (Standard/Wild/Battlegrounds), source locator/hash, capture time, sample/window and population fields. Mark all real source details unknown. Define missing/incompatible metadata behavior and label every fixture synthetic.

acceptance.text: Contract distinguishes game formats and missing metadata; fixtures contain no actual player data or unsupported current-game claims.

tasks.title: Implement bounded synthetic aggregation
tasks.description: After data-contract acceptance and verified immutable interface evidence, implement offline aggregation in the existing project stack. Reject mixed formats/patches and missing denominators; keep unknown distinct from zero. Do not add a framework or fetch live sources.

acceptance.text: Public behavior handles missing samples, conflicting versions and mixed formats using synthetic fixtures; no fabricated statistics.

tasks.title: Document a source-bound synthetic report
tasks.description: Describe results and limitations from verified synthetic outputs, separating Standard/Wild/Battlegrounds. Expose unknown patch, source, population/window and sample size without current meta or win-rate claims. Require independent evidence for the report and parent containers.

acceptance.text: Report clearly labels synthetic input, unknowns and evidence limits; no invented game recommendations, release or deployment.
